clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Aparaje, Makaba Flathoof has lost his home to the Grimtotem clan. He seeks Horde champions to strike back and keep his family safe.

Makaba Flathoof grieves for Camp Aparaje, his home in the Stonetalon Mountains. The Grimtotem clan struck without warning and laid the settlement low. Many tauren seek peace and unity under Cairne Bloodhoof, but the Grimtotem keep spreading discord and violence. Makaba is among the survivors left displaced and grieving.
